annotations.title: What each age band gets in BetterKids

description: Describe what each age band (3-4, 5-6, 7-9) gets in the app, from the real content: for example the daily activity for ages 3-4, repeat blocks in Code Quest from 5-6, one-way roads and traffic lights in mazes at 7-9. Returns counts of activities per area and sourced statements. These are facts about the app's content, not developmental milestones or advice. Send band, age_years or age_months, or nothing for all three. Read-only.

age_months.description: Child's age in months (12-216). Provide age_months OR age_years, not both. The app's content covers 36-119 months (ages 3-9).

age_years.description: Child's age in whole years (1-18). Provide age_years OR age_months, not both. The app's content covers ages 3-9.

band.description: One age band (3-4, 5-6 or 7-9). Omit to get all three.
